name: 火山の玄武岩地面
notes: Charcoal basalt with source red fissures. Broad broken-rock relief retained and scaled into a shallow walkable module. Clay confirms continuous low relief, with no spurious high-frequency dents. Runtime glow is restricted to the reconstructed red fissures, and is separate from the geometry review.

provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2; preserved dense reconstruction, source-derived reduction and separate revisions.
